  ❖ Key Operational Highlights for the Quarter: -


      ➢ Blast Furnace (BF): Achieved highest Quarterly production of 2,11,309
         MT, surpassing the previous highest of 1,97,893 MT in Q4 FY 24-25.
      ➢ Steel Dispatch: Achieved highest Quarterly dispatch of 1,63,144 MT,
         surpassing the previous highest of 1,59,022 MT in Q3 FY 24-25.
      ➢ Captive Iron Ore Mines:
         ➢ Entire Iron Ore requirement of the Integrated Steel Plant is sourced
            from captive mines.
         ➢ Achieved highest Quarterly ROM production from Chhotedongar
                mines of 8,65,614 MT, surpassing the previous highest of 6,27,123 in
                Q4 FY 24-25.
              ➢ Achieved highest Quarterly dispatches from Chhotedongar mines of
                8,07,151 MT, surpassing the previous highest of 5,99,810 in Qtr-4 FY
                24-25.
